digest.component_or_area: LLM provider framework - OpenAI model target resolution
propositions: Pydantic AI 1.107.2 emits PydanticAIDeprecationWarning when rebar constructs OpenAI model targets using the ambiguous openai: prefix, which v2 will reinterpret from Chat Completions to Responses

Inferred OpenAI provider names and legacy-explicit openai: targets are normalized to openai-chat: throughout anthropic_model.py, model_classes.py primary/fallback resolution, and fallback construction to preserve Chat Completions semantics

ProviderSession cfg.base_url builder registration and per-candidate endpoint-override gates must recognize both openai and openai-chat: qualifiers to preserve custom endpoint routing after target normalization

Real model construction and loopback custom-endpoint tests pass without PydanticAIDeprecationWarning when targets are normalized to openai-chat:, confirming wire protocol and endpoint behavior remain unchanged from Chat Completions
Documented canonical examples in LLM provider and workflow docs recommend openai-chat: spelling for OpenAI-compatible providers to reflect the operator-approved compatibility-preserving choice
